sentences.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission audited three Queensland universities to assess how effectively they prevented and dealt with research fraud.
sentences.support:
The objective of the audit was to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of the measures put in 
place

sentences.text: It reviewed research governance, sampled funded projects and examined corruption complaints and serious research-misconduct allegations, excluding technical reviews of research data and teaching-related academic integrity.
sentences.support:
It excluded any technical 
review of research data, results and outputs

sentences.text: The CCC found satisfactory prevention and complaints systems overall, while identifying improvements needed in governance, conflicts of interest, peer review, investigations and disciplinary responses.
sentences.support:
The CCC found that the three universities had in place satisfactory complaints management and 
prevention systems

sentences.text: The CCC made twenty numbered recommendations across separate lists, addressing governance, training, compliance reporting, conflicts, peer review, investigation practices and university assets.
sentences.support:
Mandate the completion of research training for all researchers and staff involved in research 
activities, and schedule refresher training at least every two years.

findings.quote:
The CCC’s audit found that one university’s investigation into research fraud did not adequately deal 
with one of the most serious allegations of corrupt conduct made as a public interest disclosure (the 
complaint).

The CCC is of the view that in this matter consideration of further disciplinary action would have 
been appropriate to promote public confidence in the integrity of the university.

notes: Metadata mismatch: the OPAX title/slug says Corruption Audits 2019-2021, but the supplied document is Reducing the risk of research fraud, July 2020. Summary follows that document. Twenty numbered recommendations are spread across seven lists (3+3+3+3+1+5+2). Findings quotes concern the university investigation and disciplinary handling, not independent findings that every underlying allegation was substantiated.
